description: The five remaining Docente routes, reusing the FEAT-001 foundation (DocenteLayout, data.ts, charts.tsx, ui.tsx, EstudianteDetalle). Routes: /docente/resultados (Resultados por curso, use client — filter dropdowns + table/list), /docente/estudiante/[id] (server page with generateStaticParams + use-client EstudianteDetalle child), /docente/competencias (Seguimiento por competencia, use client — selector + tricolor stacked bars + criteria table), /docente/evaluacion (Registro de evaluacion, use client — selectable type cards + creation panel + preview), /docente/reportes (Reportes y analitica dashboard, use client — full 3-column desktop dashboard with all chart types + strategy analysis + predictive alerts). Each page is mobile-first then desktop responsive, wraps in DocenteLayout, and uses the exact mock data from data.ts.
steps: Create d:\EduNOva\edunova-frontend\app\docente\resultados\page.tsx ('use client'). useState for Curso/Tema/Periodo filter dropdowns (static option lists; filtering may be cosmetic/visual only). Mobile: filter chips + student LIST as cards (name, nota, ProgressBar, EstadoBadge). Desktop (md:): semantic <table> wrapped in overflow-x-auto with columns #, Estudiante, Promedio, Progreso (inline bar), Estado (EstadoBadge), Accion ('Ver ficha' Link to /docente/estudiante/{id}). Render all 20 students; include a caption '20 estudiantes en total'. Wrap in <DocenteLayout>.

Create d:\EduNOva\edunova-frontend\components\docente\EstudianteDetalle.tsx ('use client') AND d:\EduNOva\edunova-frontend\app\docente\estudiante\[id]\page.tsx (NO use client — server). The page: export async function generateStaticParams() returning [{id:'1'}..{id:'20'}]; default async function Page({ params }: PageProps<'/docente/estudiante/[id]'>) { const { id } = await params; const student = estudiantes.find(e => e.id === id) ?? estudiantes[0]; return <DocenteLayout><EstudianteDetalle student={student} /></DocenteLayout>; } look up Rosa's detailed record for the canonical detail content (use rosaRecord from data.ts regardless of id for the detailed panels, but show the looked-up student's name/nota/progreso/estado in the header). EstudianteDetalle: header (avatar initials, name, nota, progreso, EstadoBadge); tabs via useState (Resumen | Evolucion | Competencias). Resumen: big nota 12.4/20, actividades 8/10 (80%), progreso +3.6. Evolucion: LineChart of Rosa weekly [10.8,11.2,11.6,11.9,12.1,12.4]. Competencias: 4 cards (Cantidad 12.4, Regularidad 11.8, Forma y movimiento 13.2, Gestion de datos 12.0) each with nota + EstadoBadge. Plus transversal skills Stars (Trabajo en equipo 3, Comunicacion 3, Gestion del tiempo 2) and a teacher-observations <textarea defaultValue={observationText}>. Mobile uses the tabs; desktop uses a side panel (avatar + stats) + main area with the tabs expanded. Use role/aria on the tab buttons (aria-selected).

Create d:\EduNOva\edunova-frontend\app\docente\competencias\page.tsx ('use client'). useState for an aula/curso selector (cosmetic). Mobile: list of the 4 competencies, each with a StackedBarChart tricolor row + the three percentages + a shared legend (Logrado/En proceso/En inicio with dot colors). Desktop (md:): grid of competency cards with stacked bars, PLUS a curricular-criteria semantic <table> (rows = sample students, columns = the 4 competencias, cells = EstadoBadge). Wrap in <DocenteLayout>.

Create d:\EduNOva\edunova-frontend\app\docente\evaluacion\page.tsx ('use client'). useState for selected evaluation type (default null or first). Mobile: selectable cards for the 5 types — Cuestionario (preguntas con puntaje), Rubrica (criterios y niveles), Lista de cotejo (verificacion), Actividad practica (proyecto/experimento), Autoevaluacion (caritas happy 😀 / neutral 😐 / sad 😢). Desktop (md:): left column lists the 5 types as selectable items; right column shows a creation form panel for the selected type (static fields only, e.g. Rubrica: a small criterios x niveles table; Autoevaluacion: the 3 caritas options; Cuestionario: a question + puntaje field) plus a 'preview' of the evaluation card. Forms are static UI only — no backend, no submit handler that does anything. Wrap in <DocenteLayout>.

Create d:\EduNOva\edunova-frontend\app\docente\reportes\page.tsx ('use client'). useState for tabs. Mobile: tabs 'Aula | Estudiante'; Aula tab: DonutChart 82% completadas + promedio por competencia bars (use BarChart single-series or ProgressBar list); Estudiante tab: student list linking to /docente/estudiante/{id} for an individual ficha. Desktop (md:): a top header with breadcrumb 'Analitica educativa > Matematica – 1B', a period <select> (cosmetic) and an 'Exportar reporte' <button>; a row of desktop tabs 'Dashboard | Resultados por curso | Seguimiento por competencia | Analisis de estrategias | Alertas predictivas | Revision docente' (Dashboard is default and shows the grid below). Dashboard = a 3-column grid: Col1 = 4 StatCards (Resumen del aula) + a 'Comparacion por tema/actividad/instrumento' block with mini sub-tabs (Tema/Actividad/Instrumento, cosmetic) + grouped BarChart (aula #17164F vs meta #A5B4FC, categories Fracciones/Decimales/Proporciones/Porcentajes); Col2 = LineChart of classroom weekly evolution (6 weeks) + 'Estudiantes del aula (20)' table with a search input + filter + visual signals (e.g. row tint or badge) for the 4 En inicio students who need support; Col3 = StackedBarChart dominio por competencia (4 rows) + Ficha de Rosa (compact stats + the same tabs/competencies). Bottom row: 'Analisis de estrategias' (Antes box neutral showing 13.4 / 68%, an arrow, Despues box green bg-[#D1FAE5] showing 15.8 / 82%, variacion +2.4 puntos (+17.9%), and the causalidad disclaimer 'La correlacion no demuestra causalidad...') AND 'Alertas predictivas' card titled 'Recomendacion para revision docente' with the disclaimer 'No es una decision automatizada ni una evaluacion definitiva' and a list of Pedro Salas (tendencia a la baja) and Rosa Quispe (mejora sostenida). Wrap the whole page in <DocenteLayout>.
